cpu_limit.description: CPU limit in cores (e.g., 0.5 = 50% of one core)

dependencies.description: List of service names this service depends on

environment_vars.description: List of environment variables to set for the service; each item is an object with 'key' and 'value' fields (both strings). Values are quoted if needed by the consuming parser (not done here — rely on caller).

exec_args.description: List of command-line arguments for the executable

exec_path.description: Absolute path to the executable binary

health_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks (only relevant if health_check_url is provided)

health_check_url.description: Optional URL to use for health checks

log_directory.description: Absolute path to the log directory

log_keep_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) of each log file before rotation

memory_limit.description: Memory limit in MB (0 = no limit)

restart_delay.description: Delay in seconds between restart attempts

run_group.description: Group account under which the service runs

run_user.description: User account under which the service runs

shutdown_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) to wait for graceful shutdown before force-terminating

working_directory.description: Absolute path to the working directory
